items.headline: Mike Locksley 'at peace' with Maryland firing, open to NFL, college OC jobs
items.description: Coach Mike Locksley says he's "at peace" with his firing by Maryland, telling ESPN that he's open to jobs in the NFL or offensive coordinator duties at a "championship" school.

items.headline: Maryland fires coach Mike Locksley amid 12-game Big Ten skid
items.description: Mike Locksley, who was 39-54 in eight seasons as football coach at Maryland, has been dismissed amid the Terrapins' 12-game Big Ten losing streak.

items.headline: Maryland fires Mike Locksley: Top candidates and roster priorities
items.description: After seven full seasons in College Park, Locksley is out, but the Terps could have some notable pieces to build around.

items.headline: Maryland fires coordinator Ted Monachino amid defensive struggles
items.description: Maryland fired defensive coordinator Ted Monachino on Sunday, a day after the team allowed at least 35 points in a fifth consecutive loss.
